title: MTRCB reminds bus operators to screen family-friendly shows only

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – In a series of transport hub inspections, the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) has reminded transport terminals and bus operators to screen content appropriate for families and children. Ahead of the All Saints’ Day travel rush, the MTRCB began inspections on Tuesday, covering bus terminals and transport hubs in Muntinlupa City, Las Piñas City, Pasay City, Parañaque City, Quezon City, Taguig City, Manila, Caloocan City, Valenzuela City, and Bocaue, Bulacan.
